telc B2 Exam: Format, Pass Mark and Study Plan

Prepare for general telc Deutsch B2 with written and oral timings, language elements, scoring, official mocks and a focused speaking and writing plan.

telc Deutsch B2 · Source checked 14 November 2026

See the exam formatOfficial mock and sources

Choose the correct examination

This guide is for general telc Deutsch B2. B2+ Beruf, B1–B2 Pflege and medical examinations have their own formats and purposes. Check the precise certificate requested by an employer or other receiving organisation.

Exam format and timing

Published task times; arrival, breaks and appointment length are separate.
PartTask timeWhat to check
Reading and language elements90 minutes combinedThree reading parts and two language-elements parts.
ListeningAbout 20 minutesThree listening parts.
Writing30 minutesOne written response to supplied input.
SpeakingAbout 15 minutesUsually a pair test, with 20 minutes of preparation.

These are the published standard task times, not a promise of total appointment length. Follow the centre’s instructions for your booked format, breaks and any approved accommodations.

Scoring and partial examinations

The linked mock allocates up to 225 written points and 75 oral points. The required minima are 135 written and 45 oral. Do not treat four Goethe-style 60/100 module marks as the telc scoring model.

The product page permits a partial examination. Confirm the conditions for a written-only or oral-only booking, prior-result credit and the available delivery format with the examination centre.

Switching from Goethe B2?

Goethe B2 has separate reading, listening, writing and speaking modules; its writing module is 75 minutes with two tasks. General telc B2 has a 30-minute writing task and language elements within a combined written examination.

Read the Goethe B2 guide before transferring a study plan between providers.

Prepare each skill

Reading and language elements

Train detailed reading, gist and selecting the matching information. In language elements, check grammatical fit and word partnerships against the paragraph’s meaning, not only the nearest noun.

Listening

Practise keeping track of attitudes, changes of plan and relevant detail at natural speed. Use the answer key to locate evidence, then replay the specific passage rather than passively repeating the whole recording.

Writing

Use the current mock to identify the requested text type and content points. Plan a clear purpose, logical paragraphs and a suitable register; reserve part of the 30 minutes for checking omissions.

Speaking

Use the mock’s sequence to rehearse presenting an experience, discussing a topic and planning together. Build on a partner’s contribution, challenge politely and bring a joint task to a concrete outcome.

Build a preparation sequence

The following is Klarweg’s study advice, not an official schedule or a promise that a set number of weeks produces this level. Adjust the sequence after a diagnostic attempt.

  1. Find the bottleneck. Complete an official mock and compare written and oral performance separately. Identify whether reading time or writing planning is limiting the result.
  2. Practise interaction. Alternate timed written responses with discussions in which a partner introduces an unexpected objection or constraint.
  3. Rehearse the booking. Use the correct paper or digital materials for the centre’s format and practise the full answer-transfer routine without extra time.

Mistakes to avoid

  • Learning a generic essay that does not answer the specified situation.
  • Treating a vocational B2 certificate as the same named product.
  • Ignoring spelling, answer transfer or partner interaction while practising only grammar.

Check readiness before booking

  • I can name the exact B2 examination on my booking.
  • I can plan and check the required written response in 30 minutes.
  • I can support a position and respond to a counterargument.
  • I understand the separate written and oral pass thresholds.

Use the official answer key for objective items. For writing and speaking, compare the published criteria and seek specific feedback; an unchecked self-score is not a reliable pass prediction.

Common questions

Is this the nursing B1–B2 exam?

No. This is general telc Deutsch B2. Nursing and other professional examinations require their own official preparation material.

Can I book a partial examination?

The general B2 product page permits partial examinations. Ask the centre which conditions and prior-result rules apply to your booking.

Fees, dates and your exam centre

Ask the examination centre for the current fee, available date, full examination name, delivery format, cancellation terms and identification rules. This guide does not sell places, guarantee availability or quote a nationwide fee.

Find an examination centre through telc and confirm that it offers your exact test. If a certificate is needed for admission, work or an official process, confirm acceptance with the receiving organisation.
